summary.intent: Coordinate and finish several parallel work packages (H managed prerelease release PRs, M status --since changed-without-changeset, G pre v3) on the callisto repo, acting on review findings from a subagent and verifying with full test suites and mutation runs.
summary.outcome: Rejected the subagent's medium finding as incorrect (exit-mode plan seeds a patch for prerelease packages) and applied its doc/message fixes plus an E165 spec rewording. Reworked M's `status --since` to count only branch-added changesets and untracked files, committed it, and both H's and M's full suites passed; the G mutants run was still pending.

repo: Release PR flow: in exit mode `plan_version` seeds a patch for every package still at a prerelease version, so `decide` opens the stable PR even for inference-only packages.
E165 verification: decisions with `consumedChangesets` compare deleted changesets to the recorded set; only older decisions fall back to 'at least one deleted'.

`status --since` previously counted every changeset on disk, so earlier-merged or pre-cycle-kept changesets excused later changes. It now counts only changesets added/changed since the ref, including untracked files.
`GitAccess::paths_differing_from` has no rename detection and keeps git's stderr; an `untracked_paths` helper was added so the `--since` diff runs three git processes regardless of workspace size.
Specs live in docs/specs/*.json (release.json, cli.json) and must stay in sync with code behavior; the edits were validated by loading the JSON afterwards.
Peer coordination rules: pull before pushing to #566/#567/#568 after the owner's merge of main; no rebase or force-push; merge order is #566, #567, then G.

code.finding: Inference for release-trigger=auto packages counts commits since tags.last_tag; v3 pre/ archives are included in consumed on exit. The subagent worried about the inference gap but the exit-mode plan seeding covers it.
E165 criterion was reworded to compare deleted direct-child changesets with the decision's recorded consumedChangesets.
Added untracked_paths helper alongside tracked_paths; used by changed_since_ref.

workflow: Concurrent background runs sharing one log file produce interleaved, misleading output; run targeted tests with separate output or only after stale runs exit.
Code changed mid-run invalidates a background full-suite run; rerun on the final commit before trusting it.
Mutation-test filters must name test binaries that exist on the target worktree/branch; a filter naming an H-only binary failed on G.
Subagent reports are not authoritative; verify claims against code before acting.

friction: Stale background nextest run mixed output with the targeted test run and later failed with exit 100.
The G mutants run failed twice: the first filter referenced a test binary that exists only on H, and the package flags didn't apply.
The sandbox blocked an in-place `sed -i` edit of the mutants script, so the unchanged script started again and had to be stopped and rewritten.
open_items: G mutants run was still in progress and its results are unchecked.
Push of H's and M's commits to remote branches is pending; branches #566/#567/#568 must be pulled first and not rebased or force-pushed.
Pre-cycle test coverage for auto/inferred packages in `release_pr_pre_cycle_tests.rs` was suggested by the subagent but not added.
